People Activation System
The Only System Connecting Employee Listening, Learning, and Activation
Go beyond optimization. Activate your workforce.
 Talk to an Expert
The Problem
Insight Without Action Leaves Behavior Unchanged
The listening side and the learning side of most HR tech stacks sit in separate systems, managed by different teams, measuring different things, and neither side can prove the business measurably improved from the investment.
The Listening Side
HR runs a survey, managers get a dashboard, and the moment passes before...
HR runs a survey, managers get a dashboard, and the moment passes before anything changes. Perceptyx benchmark data spanning 20+ years shows post-survey action rates have barely improved over the past decade, even with AI analytics and increasingly sophisticated dashboards.
The Learning Side
Learning data tells you what was delivered — not whether anyone learned...
Learning data tells you what was delivered — not whether anyone learned, or whether it stuck. Decades of research on skill decay show the majority of training content is forgotten within weeks, regardless of course design or platform sophistication.
The Missing Link
Connecting an employee experience tool to an LMS shifts data...
Connecting an employee experience tool to an LMS shifts data between systems; it does not fix the fact that course completions were never measuring learning in the first place. Neither side can prove behavior changed on the job, or that the business improved because of it.
Talk to an Expert
The Shift
One System. One Loop. One Answer to "Did It Work?"
The Perceptyx People Activation System connects what the organization hears from its people to what they learn and how they behave, on a single native data model rather than a stack of integrations. Listening signals tell you what to build. Learning evidence tells you whether it worked. Continuous application and reinforcement in-the-flow-of-work makes it durable. Each new listening cycle gets smarter because of what happened in between.
Talk to an Expert
How it Works
The People Activation System Empowers Your Entire Organization
Three product families on one native data model, powered by a system of interconnected AI agents. Any pillar works alone, but they’re supercharged within the full system.
DiscoverFind What Matters Most, Right Now
Continuous, multi-channel listening grounded in 20+ years of benchmarked data. Four listening channels feed one signal engine: Point-in-Time Surveys, Lifecycle Surveys, 360 Feedback, and Crowdsourcing & Voting along with our Conversational Listening Agent and Narrative Analysis Agent. Discover translates employee feedback into plain-language direction instead of stopping at the dashboard.
Explore Discover
ActivateDrive Change Where Work Happens
The Nudge Agent and Coaching Agent deliver targeted interventions to the right person before the moment passes — such as after a learner completes a Develop experience, or when a manager receives feedback from Discover — then reinforces those new behaviors.
Explore Activate
DevelopBuild Real Capabilities to Perform
Adaptive one-on-one conversational learning that scores each learner against structured learning objectives, with knowledge gaps rolling up across the cohort. Develop is a multi-agent architecture that converts content, adapts to each learner, and validates comprehension to prove that real learning took place.
Explore Develop
AI Agents: Turn Insight Into Action and Capability
A suite of AI agents purpose-built to turn signals into action and learning into behavior, each doing a specific job inside the People Activation Loop.
Explore AI Agents

Proven Customer Impact

Built on Research, Not Assumptions
Every survey question, every nudge, every learning objective traces back to research-backed behaviors that predict business outcomes. Training paired with reinforcement nudges produces durable behavior change at eight months, and training alone does not.
